title: Durable quorum commit
statement: The system shall lose 0 acknowledged writes when every node loses power simultaneously, acknowledging a write only after a majority of the shard's voting replicas have fsynced it.
rationale: Prevents loss of acknowledged writes on correlated power loss. Analytics replicas never count toward the quorum.

acceptance_criteria.text: After power-cutting all nodes of a 3-voter shard immediately after acknowledgment, every acknowledged write is present on restart (1,000 trials, zero losses).
With only one voter plus any number of analytics replicas reachable, writes to that shard are not acknowledged.
